worker_claim.report: Against 90de39375177b34923e2c81df8e2e06158323a4e: production +124/-56 (net +68); tests/support +161/-40 (net +121). The shared observer inspects only ticket-changing first-parent commits, and status reuses its observed trees for the selected ticket's strict admission check without durable caching. TASK-102 visibility is independent of unrelated workers/product changes; TASK-137 product-lineage, ownership and immutable-content admission requirements remain enforced. Real-Git regressions cover the incident across restart and human/JSON CLI, matching uncertain ownership/recovery, terminal transitions/removal/requeue, changed/recreated identity, dirty/unpublished/divergent/inaccessible control observations, retained reports, and actual admission. Focused suite: 164 passed. Final full configured parallel suite: 1844 passed, 2 skipped. Ruff and git diff --check passed. Combined statement/branch coverage: 79%; four transient download/timing failures in the initial coverage run passed on focused rerun, followed by the clean full suite. Hosted exact-checkpoint CI was not initiated because checkpoint publication and Git lifecycle belong to Devlegate.
worker_claim.summary: Consolidated failure lifecycle proof into one read-only first-parent ticket-history observation shared by separate status-visibility and strict admission policies. Published obsolete failures stay hidden during unrelated activity, while matching ownership, ambiguous ticket identity and unsafe admission remain fail-closed. Reduced cumulative production and test changes while preserving historical evidence.
